about.title: About me
about.long:
Front-End Developer with 8+ years of experience building responsive and interactive web experiences. Specialized in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, with a strong focus on animations, HTML5 banners, and email development.

Experienced in working with digital marketing technologies such as AEM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo Engage, and ON24, managing campaign assets, integrations, and data workflows.

Passionate about creating high-performance user interfaces, combining design, development, and marketing to deliver engaging digital solutions.

items.desc:
• Supported digital marketing strategies through event management, data handling, and technology tools
• Developed corporate webinars focused on lead generation and user engagement
• Configured, tested, and provided technical support during live events, ensuring a seamless experience
• Trained users and internal teams on the use of ON24 platform
• Created and managed leads in CRM systems, ensuring data quality and proper segmentation
• Analyzed data using Excel to optimize campaigns and improve conversion rates
• Collaborated with marketing and technology teams on digital initiatives

• Developed interactive HTML5 banners for digital campaigns (ads, display, rich media)
• Built responsive HTML emails, optimized for multiple email clients
• Implemented animations and microinteractions using JavaScript and CSS
• Optimized file size and performance to meet advertising platform standards (ad networks)
• Adapted creatives to multiple formats and resolutions (multi-size ads)

• Developed responsive HTML5 emails and interactive banners, ensuring industry standards and cross-client compatibility
• Implemented animations and microinteractions using JavaScript and libraries such as GSAP
• Maintained and optimized landing pages, improving performance and user experience
• Supported and developed desktop applications using Electron
• Collaborated on frontend projects using Angular to build dynamic user interfaces
• Managed version control and team collaboration through GitHub
• Maintained and updated content using Drupal CMS
• Worked closely with design and development teams to ensure visual and functional consistency
